pages.title: Eight Modes
pages.text:
Dolls have 8 work modes, switched via the Remote panel:

Combat
• Melee: actively attacks hostile mobs within 8 blocks; needs a sword or axe in its inventory
• Archer: shoots with a bow or crossbow, auto-draws and reloads

Gathering
• Woodcutting: finds trees and fells the whole tree; needs an axe in its inventory
• Mining: automatically finds and chain-mines connected ores, and tunnels forward; needs a pickaxe in its inventory
• Fishing: auto-fishes near water; mutually exclusive with Follow

Support
• Farming: tills a 9x9 field, plants, harvests, replants; needs a hoe in its inventory
• Feeding: throws food to the owner when hungry or injured
• Torch Placing: places torches in areas with light level below 8

pages.title: Switching Modes
pages.text:
Right-click with the Remote to open the control panel, which lists all living dolls. Click a button to switch a mode; the highlighted button is the active mode.

• Clicking an already-active mode button deselects it and returns to idle
• The Follow toggle is independent of the 8 modes and can be toggled separately
• Fishing and Follow are mutually exclusive: enabling one auto-disables the other
• Mode changes take effect immediately, no need to resummon the doll
• The required tool must be in the doll's inventory, otherwise gathering modes cannot work
